column3: Setup: Use the application_state_change testdrive - it supplies a Ready-status new application titled 'Application State Change - Reject New Application <run_seed>'. OR provide one yourself.

Setup: Important: the testdrive page tears down its data as soon as you navigate away from it. Log in and run the test in a separate browser tab/window, leaving the testdrive tab open until you have finished.
Go to the "Applications/Update Requests" page in the Administration area
Search for the testdrive's "Reject New Application" record (it is in status Ready) and click "Review application"
Complete any required fields, and then change the Application Status to "Rejected"

column4: A flash message indicates that the application record was updated
